## Two-direction motor

Inputs: `forward`, `backward`, `stop` (three push buttons wired normally open (NO), at 0 at rest). Outputs: `motor_fwd`, `motor_rev`.

### Task

1. `forward` starts `motor_fwd`, which keeps running after release (self-holding with stop priority).
2. `backward` starts `motor_rev` the same way.
3. `stop` cuts both outputs.
4. When one direction is running, pressing the other button has no effect.
5. The two outputs are never true at the same time (short circuit on real contactors).

texts.forwardDescription: Self-holding with stop priority, interlocked by the reverse run.
texts.backwardDescription: Self-holding with stop priority, interlocked by the forward run.
